name: Unico 20 87 Hotel Riviera Maya
insider_take: This adults-only sanctuary sits on a pristine stretch of Caribbean coastline where ancient Mayan ruins meet modern luxury, offering an intimate escape just 20 minutes from Playa del Carmen.
whats_special: Unico 20 87 is built around a stunning cenote - a natural freshwater sinkhole sacred to the ancient Maya. The hotel's name references its location at 20° latitude and 87° longitude, precisely marking this magical spot on the Riviera Maya. With only 35 suites, it's one of the most exclusive resorts in the region, featuring a unique "local host" program where each guest is paired with a personal concierge.
pro_tip: Book the Cenote Suite for direct access to the property's private cenote - you can literally swim in crystal-clear waters right from your terrace while tropical fish glide beneath you.
dont_miss: The underground Cenote Spa treatment rooms carved into natural limestone caves, and the hotel's signature "Mayan Tasting Journey" featuring indigenous ingredients like cacao, vanilla, and achiote - all native to this exact region and used by Maya civilizations for over 1,000 years.
pros: All-inclusive luxury resort with premium dining and beverage options
Sophisticated adults-only environment with personalized service
Prime beachfront location on Riviera Maya's pristine coastline
Culturally-inspired design celebrating local Mexican heritage and artistry
cons: Adults-only policy restricts families with children
Premium luxury pricing may limit accessibility
